scenario.title: Unsafe Acts
scenario.summary: Identifying behavioral risks and unsafe actions.
scenario.mission: Observe the workers and identify unsafe acts or behaviors. Consider Human Factors and Last Minute Risk Assessments.

hazards.title: Bypassing safety guard
hazards.feedback: Correct. Bypassing machine guards is a critical unsafe act and highly dangerous.
hazards.reviewText: Never remove or bypass safety guards on equipment.

hazards.title: Using mobile phone while walking
hazards.feedback: Correct. Distraction causes many accidents in operational areas.
hazards.reviewText: Stay alert; do not use mobile phones while walking in operational areas.

hazards.title: Rushing / Running
hazards.feedback: Correct. Running increases the risk of slips, trips, and collisions.

hazards.title: Throwing items instead of passing
hazards.feedback: Correct. Throwing items can cause injury or damage.
hazards.reviewText: Hand over items safely; do not throw them.

questions.explanation: LMRA is a Last Minute Risk Assessment done immediately before starting a task.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of an LMRA?
questions.explanation: It helps identify any immediate hazards that may have been missed or changed.

options.label: To pause and check for immediate hazards before starting work
To fill out paperwork for HR
To clock in for the shift

questions.prompt: Which of these is considered a 'Human Factor' that increases risk?
questions.explanation: Fatigue significantly impairs judgement and reaction times.

questions.prompt: If you see a colleague performing an unsafe act, you should...
questions.explanation: Safety is everyone's responsibility. Intervene politely but firmly.

options.label: Wait until the next safety meeting to mention it

questions.prompt: Why do people sometimes bypass safety guards?
questions.explanation: Time pressure is a common, but unacceptable, reason for bypassing safety features.

options.label: To save time or increase production speed
Because the guards are too heavy
Because guards are only for decoration
